Functions to plot QTL (quantitative trait loci) analysis results and
related diagnostics. Part of 'qtl2', an upgrade of the 'qtl' package to
better handle high-dimensional data and complex cross designs.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`color_patterns_get()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/color_patterns_get.md)
  : Set up col, pattern and group for plotting.
- [`color_patterns_pheno()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/color_patterns_pheno.md)
  : Set up col, pattern, shape and group for plotting.
- [`color_patterns_set()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/color_patterns_set.md)
  : Set up colors for patterns or points
- [`ggplot_coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_coef.md)
  [`ggplot_coefCC()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_coef.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_coef.md)
  : Plot QTL effects along chromosome
- [`ggplot_genes()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_genes.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<genes>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_genes.md)
  : Plot gene locations for a genomic interval
- [`ggplot_genes_internal()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_genes_internal.md)
  : GGPlot internal routine for ggplot_genes
- [`ggplot_listof_scan1coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<listof_scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_listof_scan1coef.md)
  : Plot of object of class listof_scan1coeff
- [`ggplot_onegeno()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_onegeno.md)
  : Plot one individual's genome-wide genotypes
- [`ggplot_peaks()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_peaks.md)
  : Plot QTL peak locations
- [`ggplot_pxg()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_pxg.md)
  [`mean_pxg()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_pxg.md)
  : Plot phenotype vs genotype
- [`ggplot_scan1()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_scan1.md)
  [`autoplot(`*`<scan1>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_scan1.md)
  [`ggplot_scan1_internal()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_scan1.md)
  : Plot a genome scan
- [`ggplot_snpasso()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/ggplot_snpasso.md)
  : Plot SNP associations
- [`listof_scan1coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`summary_listof_scan1coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`summary(`*`<listof_scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`summary_scan1coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`summary(`*`<scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`subset_listof_scan1coef()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`subset(`*`<listof_scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<listof_scan1coef>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/listof_scan1coef.md)
  : List of scan1coef objects
- [`sdp_to_pattern()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/sdp_to_pattern.md)
  : Convert sdp to pattern
- [`summary_scan1()`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/summary_scan1.md)
  [`summary(`*`<scan1>`*`)`](https://byandell-sysgen.github.io/qtl2ggplot/reference/summary_scan1.md)
  : Summary of scan1 object
